# CampusConnect project guidance

- Keep this learning project beginner-friendly and use Java 25 or newer.
- Frontend uses semantic HTML, CSS, vanilla JavaScript, and Vite; avoid adding a UI framework.
- Backend uses the JDK HTTP server, plain JDBC, Jackson for JSON, and MySQL; preserve prepared statements.
- Keep the backend small and update README setup/API notes when behavior changes.
- Update README setup/API notes whenever project behavior or configuration changes.
